description: Renovate opens update PRs. Minor, patch and digest updates merge themselves once the validate check passes; majors and the hand-installed Argo CD chart wait for a manual merge.

customManagers.description: Argo CD Helm chart version. It is installed by hand with helm, so merging this PR does not deploy it: run the helm upgrade in infra/argocd/values.yaml afterwards.

packageRules.description: Minor, patch and digest updates merge themselves through GitHub auto-merge once the required validate check passes.
Merging the Argo CD chart bump does not deploy it (helm upgrade by hand), so it stays a manual merge as a reminder.
Portfolio CI pins its own digest right after each build (auto-merging PR from anakafeel/portfolio-website), so Renovate leaves this image alone.
n8n is pinned to 1.106.3: newer releases SIGBUS-crash on the Pi (see images/n8n/Dockerfile). Retest by hand before any bump.
